title: The Structure and Classification of Misere Quotients
notes: Every finite nontrivial misere quotient has even order; there is no order-4 quotient; orders 1, 2, 6, and 8 are unique. The complete classification with |P|=2 is the T_n and R_n families, including infinite limits. Computational enumeration through order 18 is recorded. A reduced bipartite monoid is a misere quotient iff it admits a valid transition table. No general classification of all finite quotients.
